params.prompt: Original museum-quality oil painting on canvas: an empty two-lane highway crossing black lava fields on the Big Island of Hawaii at dawn, a single time-trial cyclist far away as a small dark silhouette in an aero tuck, heat shimmer, pink and gold sky over a volcano, thick impasto brushwork. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks.

Original expressive oil painting: fierce crosswinds on a coastal lava highway, dry golden fountain grass bent flat, a blurred abstract cyclist leaning into the wind, turquoise ocean on the horizon, energetic diagonal brushstrokes. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks.

Original gouache painting: green rolling hills of North Kohala, Hawaii, under drifting trade-wind clouds, a winding road turning back on itself, flat graphic shapes, soft pastel palette, mid-century travel-poster feeling but painterly. No text, no letters, no logos.

Original painting of a mass open-water swim start in a tropical bay at sunrise seen from above, thousands of tiny swim caps rendered as dots of bright colour on deep blue water, white splashes, a pier on one side, dotted pointillist technique, luminous. No text, no letters, no logos, no identifiable people.

Original minimalist ink painting on warm paper: white smoke streamlines flowing smoothly around an abstract teardrop airfoil shape in a wind tunnel, black sumi ink, lots of empty space, calm and precise. No text, no letters, no logos, no signature.

Original Japanese-inspired brush painting: the side silhouette of a generic time-trial bicycle with disc wheels drawn in a few confident black brushstrokes, surrounded by flowing air currents in pale indigo washes, on textured rice paper. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no seal stamps.

Original oil painting: an empty indoor wooden velodrome at night, steep banked boards glowing under a few lamps, a single track cyclist as a motion blur on the banking, deep shadows, cinematic warm and cool light. No text, no letters, no logos, no advertising boards.

Original impressionist oil painting: a seaside town street at midnight during a long-distance race, a lit finish arch glowing warm, paper lanterns, palm trees, a crowd rendered as loose blurred strokes, reflections on wet asphalt. No text, no letters, no logos, no readable signs.

Original abstract expressionist colour-field painting: molten orange lava meeting black ocean water, rising white steam, large bold fields of colour, thick scraped paint, dramatic contrast. No text, no letters, no logos, no signature.

Original surreal oil painting: a desert road through black lava dissolving into a white-hot heat mirage, the horizon melting into light, a lone runner as a tiny figure, bleached palette with a single cobalt sky band. No text, no letters, no logos.

Original chiaroscuro still-life oil painting: a frame builder's workbench with steel bicycle tubes, brass lugs, a brazing torch and hand files, lit by one window, deep Dutch-master shadows. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks.

Original geometric abstract painting inspired by woven carbon fibre: interlaced black and gold bands forming a shimmering twill pattern that bends like a wave, gold leaf accents, precise hard-edge style. No text, no letters, no logos.
